items.question: Trong câu "An IT Business Analyst turns business needs into something a technical team can build precisely — and turns technical capability into something business people can understand.", từ "precisely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An IT Business Analyst turns business needs into something a technical team can build precisely — and turns technical capability into something business people can understand.", what does "precisely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: precisely /prɪˈsaɪs.li/ (trạng từ): chính xác. Cụm hay gặp: define precisely (xác định chính xác); tính từ: precise.
items.explanationEn: precisely /prɪˈsaɪs.li/ (adverb): exactly. Common collocation: define precisely; adjective: precise.

items.question: Trong câu "An IT Business Analyst turns business needs into something a technical team can build precisely — and turns technical capability into something business people can understand.", từ "capability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An IT Business Analyst turns business needs into something a technical team can build precisely — and turns technical capability into something business people can understand.", what does "capability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): năng lực, khả năng. "Technical capability" = năng lực kỹ thuật (hệ thống làm được gì); tính từ: capable of (có khả năng).
items.explanationEn: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (noun): the power to do something. "Technical capability" is what the technology is able to do; adjective: capable of.

items.question: Trong câu "The gap between those two sentences is exactly where the BA stands.", từ "gap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The gap between those two sentences is exactly where the BA stands.", what does "gap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gap /ɡæp/ (danh từ): khoảng cách, sự chênh lệch. Cụm hay gặp: bridge the gap (lấp khoảng cách), gap analysis (phân tích khoảng trống).
items.explanationEn: gap /ɡæp/ (noun): a divide between two things. Common phrases: bridge the gap, gap analysis.

items.question: Trong câu "The developer is not wrong either — they need precision to write code.", từ "precision" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The developer is not wrong either — they need precision to write code.", what does "precision" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: precision /prɪˈsɪʒ.ən/ (danh từ): độ chính xác. Lập trình viên cần "precision" (chi tiết chính xác) để viết code; tính từ: precise.
items.explanationEn: precision /prɪˈsɪʒ.ən/ (noun): exactness. Developers need precision, exact details, to write code; adjective: precise.

items.question: Trong câu "Neither of them owns bridging that gap; that is the BA's job.", từ "bridge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Neither of them owns bridging that gap; that is the BA's job.", what does "bridge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bridge /brɪdʒ/ (động từ): kết nối, lấp khoảng trống. Là danh từ "bridge" = cây cầu; là động từ "bridge the gap" = lấp khoảng cách giữa hai bên.
items.explanationEn: bridge /brɪdʒ/ (verb): to connect across a gap. As a noun a bridge crosses a river; as a verb, "bridge the gap" means connecting two sides.

items.question: Trong câu "These misconceptions disappoint many newcomers:", từ "misconception" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These misconceptions disappoint many newcomers:", what does "misconception" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: misconception /ˌmɪs.kənˈsep.ʃən/ (danh từ): quan niệm sai lầm. Tiền tố "mis-" = sai: misconception, misunderstand; cụm: a common misconception (quan niệm sai phổ biến).
items.explanationEn: misconception /ˌmɪs.kənˈsep.ʃən/ (noun): a mistaken belief. The prefix "mis-" means wrongly: misconception, misunderstand; phrase: a common misconception.

items.question: Trong câu "These misconceptions disappoint many newcomers:", từ "disappoint" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These misconceptions disappoint many newcomers:", what does "disappoint" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: disappoint /ˌdɪs.əˈpɔɪnt/ (động từ): làm thất vọng. Tính từ: disappointed (thất vọng), disappointing (gây thất vọng).
items.explanationEn: disappoint /ˌdɪs.əˈpɔɪnt/ (verb): to let down. Adjectives: disappointed (feeling let down), disappointing (causing that feeling).

items.question: Trong câu "These misconceptions disappoint many newcomers:", từ "newcomer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These misconceptions disappoint many newcomers:", what does "newcomer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: newcomer /ˈnuːˌkʌm.ɚ/ (danh từ): người mới vào nghề. "Newcomers to the BA role" = những người mới bước vào nghề BA.
items.explanationEn: newcomer /ˈnuːˌkʌm.ɚ/ (noun): a recent arrival. "Newcomers to the BA role" are people who have just started in the job.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA analyses rather than transcribes.", từ "transcribe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA analyses rather than transcribes.", what does "transcribe" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to copy down word for word
items.explanation: transcribe /trænˈskraɪb/ (động từ): chép lại nguyên văn. BA không chỉ "transcribe" (ghi lại y nguyên lời khách) mà phải phân tích; danh từ: transcript.
items.explanationEn: transcribe /trænˈskraɪb/ (verb): to copy down word for word. A BA does not just transcribe what the customer says but analyses it; noun: transcript.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA clarifies and advises; the decision belongs to whoever holds business authority", từ "clarify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA clarifies and advises; the decision belongs to whoever holds business authority", what does "clarify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clarify /ˈkler.ə.faɪ/ (động từ): làm rõ. Cụm hay gặp: clarify requirements (làm rõ yêu cầu); danh từ: clarification.
items.explanationEn: clarify /ˈkler.ə.faɪ/ (verb): to make clear. Common collocation: clarify requirements; noun: clarification.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA clarifies and advises; the decision belongs to whoever holds business authority", từ "advise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA clarifies and advises; the decision belongs to whoever holds business authority", what does "advise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: advise /ədˈvaɪz/ (động từ): tư vấn, khuyên. Chú ý: advise (động từ, /z/) và advice (danh từ, /s/).
items.explanationEn: advise /ədˈvaɪz/ (verb): to give advice. Note: advise is the verb (/z/) and advice is the noun (/s/).

items.question: Trong câu "A BA clarifies and advises; the decision belongs to whoever holds business authority", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA clarifies and advises; the decision belongs to whoever holds business authority", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /əˈθɔːr.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): quyền quyết định. Quyết định thuộc về người có "business authority" (thẩm quyền kinh doanh); "an authority on X" lại là chuyên gia về X.
items.explanationEn: authority /əˈθɔːr.ə.t̬i/ (noun): power to make decisions. The decision belongs to whoever has business authority; "an authority on X" means an expert on X.

items.question: Trong câu "If you merely forward information intact, your role could be replaced by an email.", từ "merely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you merely forward information intact, your role could be replaced by an email.", what does "merely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: merely /ˈmɪr.li/ (trạng từ): chỉ đơn thuần. "Merely forward" = chỉ chuyển tiếp mà không thêm giá trị; tính từ: mere (chỉ là).
items.explanationEn: merely /ˈmɪr.li/ (adverb): only, simply. "Merely forward" means only passing on without adding anything; adjective: mere.

items.question: Trong câu "If you merely forward information intact, your role could be replaced by an email.", từ "intact" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you merely forward information intact, your role could be replaced by an email.", what does "intact" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: intact /ɪnˈtækt/ (tính từ): nguyên vẹn. "Forward information intact" = chuyển thông tin nguyên xi, không xử lý gì; cụm: remain intact (vẫn nguyên vẹn).
items.explanationEn: intact /ɪnˈtækt/ (adjective): whole, unchanged. "Forward information intact" means passing it on untouched; phrase: remain intact.

items.question: Trong câu "Eliciting and clarifying needs.", từ "elicit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Eliciting and clarifying needs.", what does "elicit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (động từ): khai thác, gợi ra. "Elicit requirements" = khai thác yêu cầu qua phỏng vấn, workshop...; danh từ: elicitation.
items.explanationEn: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (verb): to draw out. "Elicit requirements" means drawing them out through interviews and workshops; noun: elicitation.

items.question: Trong câu "Interviews, workshops, observing users at real work, reading existing documents and data.", từ "observe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Interviews, workshops, observing users at real work, reading existing documents and data.", what does "observe" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: observe /əbˈzɝːv/ (động từ): quan sát. Quan sát người dùng làm việc thật giúp thấy điều họ không nói ra; "observe the rules" lại là tuân thủ quy định.
items.explanationEn: observe /əbˈzɝːv/ (verb): to watch carefully. Observing users at work reveals what they do not say; "observe the rules" means to obey them.

items.question: Trong câu "Turning raw information into structure: business processes, data flows, states, rules, exception cases.", từ "raw" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Turning raw information into structure: business processes, data flows, states, rules, exception cases.", what does "raw" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: raw /rɑː/ (tính từ): thô, chưa xử lý. Cụm hay gặp: raw data (dữ liệu thô), raw material (nguyên liệu thô).
items.explanationEn: raw /rɑː/ (adjective): unprocessed. Common phrases: raw data, raw material.

items.question: Trong câu "Turning raw information into structure: business processes, data flows, states, rules, exception cases.", từ "exception" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Turning raw information into structure: business processes, data flows, states, rules, exception cases.", what does "exception" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: exception /ɪkˈsep.ʃən/ (danh từ): ngoại lệ. "Exception cases" = các trường hợp ngoại lệ; cụm: with the exception of (ngoại trừ).
items.explanationEn: exception /ɪkˈsep.ʃən/ (noun): something outside the norm. "Exception cases" are cases outside the normal flow; phrase: with the exception of.

items.question: Trong câu "This creates the most value and is the most frequently skipped step when a BA is rushed.", từ "skip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This creates the most value and is the most frequently skipped step when a BA is rushed.", what does "skip" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: skip /skɪp/ (động từ): bỏ qua. "Skip a step" = bỏ qua một bước; cụm: skip a meeting (bỏ một buổi họp).
items.explanationEn: skip /skɪp/ (verb): to leave out. "Skip a step" means leaving it out; phrase: skip a meeting.

items.question: Trong câu "This creates the most value and is the most frequently skipped step when a BA is rushed.", từ "rush" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This creates the most value and is the most frequently skipped step when a BA is rushed.", what does "rush" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rush /rʌʃ/ (động từ): hối thúc, làm vội. "Be rushed" = bị hối thúc, không đủ thời gian; cụm: in a rush (đang vội).
items.explanationEn: rush /rʌʃ/ (verb): to hurry. "Be rushed" means being hurried without enough time; phrase: in a rush.

items.question: Trong câu "Writing user stories, acceptance criteria, documents, drawing diagrams, sketching wireframes.", từ "criterion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Writing user stories, acceptance criteria, documents, drawing diagrams, sketching wireframes.", what does "criterion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: criterion /kraɪˈtɪr.i.ən/ (danh từ): tiêu chí. Số nhiều: criteria; "acceptance criteria" = tiêu chí nghiệm thu của user story.
items.explanationEn: criterion /kraɪˈtɪr.i.ən/ (noun): a standard for judging. Plural: criteria; acceptance criteria are the conditions a user story must meet.

items.question: Trong câu "Writing user stories, acceptance criteria, documents, drawing diagrams, sketching wireframes.", từ "sketch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Writing user stories, acceptance criteria, documents, drawing diagrams, sketching wireframes.", what does "sketch" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: sketch /sketʃ/ (động từ): phác thảo. "Sketch wireframes" = phác thảo khung giao diện; danh từ "sketch" còn là tiểu phẩm hài.
items.explanationEn: sketch /sketʃ/ (verb): to draw roughly. "Sketch wireframes" means drawing rough screen layouts; the noun "sketch" is also a comedy scene.

items.question: Trong câu "Each representation serves a different audience.", từ "audience" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each representation serves a different audience.", what does "audience" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: audience /ˈɑː.di.əns/ (danh từ): đối tượng người xem. Mỗi tài liệu phục vụ một "audience" khác nhau (dev, tester, khách hàng); cụm: target audience (đối tượng mục tiêu).
items.explanationEn: audience /ˈɑː.di.əns/ (noun): the people it is for. Each document serves a different audience such as developers, testers or clients; phrase: target audience.

items.question: Trong câu "Answering developers' questions, clarifying when testers find ambiguity, supporting UAT, and confirming that what was delivered is what was agreed.", từ "ambiguity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Answering developers' questions, clarifying when testers find ambiguity, supporting UAT, and confirming that what was delivered is what was agreed.", what does "ambiguity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ambiguity /ˌæm.bəˈɡjuː.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): sự mơ hồ. Tính từ: ambiguous (mơ hồ, có thể hiểu nhiều cách); cụm: remove ambiguity (loại bỏ sự mơ hồ).
items.explanationEn: ambiguity /ˌæm.bəˈɡjuː.ə.t̬i/ (noun): unclear meaning. Adjective: ambiguous; phrase: remove ambiguity.

items.question: Trong câu "The result is documentation that looks complete while the team keeps asking questions, and a delivery that still misses expectations.", từ "expectation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The result is documentation that looks complete while the team keeps asking questions, and a delivery that still misses expectations.", what does "expectation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: expectation /ˌek.spekˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): kỳ vọng. Cụm hay gặp: miss expectations (không đạt kỳ vọng), meet/exceed expectations (đạt/vượt kỳ vọng).
items.explanationEn: expectation /ˌek.spekˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): hopes. Common phrases: miss expectations, meet or exceed expectations.

items.question: Trong câu "BA work rarely runs in a tidy sequence.", từ "rarely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BA work rarely runs in a tidy sequence.", what does "rarely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: rarely /ˈrer.li/ (trạng từ): hiếm khi. Đồng nghĩa: seldom; tính từ: rare (hiếm).
items.explanationEn: rarely /ˈrer.li/ (adverb): not often. Synonym: seldom; adjective: rare.

items.question: Trong câu "BA work rarely runs in a tidy sequence.", từ "tidy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BA work rarely runs in a tidy sequence.", what does "tidy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tidy /ˈtaɪ.di/ (tính từ): gọn gàng, ngăn nắp. "A tidy sequence" = trình tự gọn gàng, lần lượt; động từ: tidy up (dọn dẹp).
items.explanationEn: tidy /ˈtaɪ.di/ (adjective): neat and orderly. "A tidy sequence" is a neat, step-by-step order; phrasal verb: tidy up.

items.question: Trong câu "BA work rarely runs in a tidy sequence.", từ "sequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BA work rarely runs in a tidy sequence.", what does "sequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (danh từ): trình tự. Cụm hay gặp: in sequence (theo thứ tự), sequence diagram (biểu đồ tuần tự).
items.explanationEn: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (noun): an order of steps. Common phrases: in sequence, sequence diagram.

items.question: Trong câu "Join the daily standup to learn who is blocked and where — many blockers turn out to be unclear requirements.", từ "blocked" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Join the daily standup to learn who is blocked and where — many blockers turn out to be unclear requirements.", what does "blocked" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: blocked /blɑːkt/ (tính từ): bị vướng, kẹt việc. Trong standup, "I am blocked" = tôi đang bị vướng, cần người khác gỡ.
items.explanationEn: blocked /blɑːkt/ (adjective): unable to move forward. In a standup, "I am blocked" means you cannot continue until someone helps.

items.question: Trong câu "Join the daily standup to learn who is blocked and where — many blockers turn out to be unclear requirements.", từ "blocker" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Join the daily standup to learn who is blocked and where — many blockers turn out to be unclear requirements.", what does "blocker" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: blocker /ˈblɑː.kɚ/ (danh từ): trở ngại. "Blocker" là vấn đề chặn tiến độ; cụm: remove a blocker (gỡ trở ngại).
items.explanationEn: blocker /ˈblɑː.kɚ/ (noun): an obstacle. A blocker is an issue that stops progress; phrase: remove a blocker.

items.question: Trong câu "Join the daily standup to learn who is blocked and where — many blockers turn out to be unclear requirements.", từ "turn out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Join the daily standup to learn who is blocked and where — many blockers turn out to be unclear requirements.", what does "turn out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: turn out /tɝːn aʊt/ (cụm từ): hóa ra là. "Turn out to be" = hóa ra là; cụm động từ này còn có nghĩa tắt đèn, sản xuất, đuổi ra.
items.explanationEn: turn out /tɝːn aʊt/ (phrase): to prove to be. "Turn out to be" means to prove to be; the phrasal verb can also mean to switch off, produce or expel.

items.question: Trong câu "Is this field mandatory or optional?", từ "mandatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is this field mandatory or optional?", what does "mandatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tɔːr.i/ (tính từ): bắt buộc. Trường "mandatory" phải nhập mới lưu được; đồng nghĩa: required, compulsory.
items.explanationEn: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tɔːr.i/ (adjective): required. A mandatory field must be filled in before saving; synonyms: required, compulsory.

items.question: Trong câu "What shows if the user lacks permission?", từ "lack" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What shows if the user lacks permission?", what does "lack" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lack /læk/ (động từ): thiếu, không có. "Lack" là động từ không cần giới từ: lack permission; danh từ: a lack of (sự thiếu).
items.explanationEn: lack /læk/ (verb): to be without. As a verb "lack" takes no preposition: lack permission; noun: a lack of.

items.question: Trong câu "Sit with a tester over a bug: is it a code defect, or a case the requirement never covered?", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sit with a tester over a bug: is it a code defect, or a case the requirement never covered?", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (danh từ): lỗi, khiếm khuyết. "Code defect" = lỗi trong code; động từ "defect" (/dɪˈfekt/) lại là đào tẩu, bỏ phe.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (noun): a flaw. A code defect is a flaw in the code; the verb "defect" (/dɪˈfekt/) means to leave one side for another.

items.question: Trong câu "Sit with a tester over a bug: is it a code defect, or a case the requirement never covered?", từ "cover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sit with a tester over a bug: is it a code defect, or a case the requirement never covered?", what does "cover" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cover /ˈkʌv.ɚ/ (động từ): bao quát, tính đến. "A case the requirement never covered" = trường hợp yêu cầu chưa từng tính đến; cụm: test coverage (độ bao phủ kiểm thử).
items.explanationEn: cover /ˈkʌv.ɚ/ (verb): to deal with, include. "A case the requirement never covered" is a case it did not include; related: test coverage.

items.question: Trong câu "Update the process documentation and send it out for confirmation.", từ "confirmation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Update the process documentation and send it out for confirmation.", what does "confirmation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: confirmation /ˌkɑːn.fɚˈmeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự xác nhận. "Send it out for confirmation" = gửi đi để các bên xác nhận; động từ: confirm.
items.explanationEn: confirmation /ˌkɑːn.fɚˈmeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): verification. "Send it out for confirmation" means sending it so others can confirm it is right; verb: confirm.

items.question: Trong câu "What every day has in common: you constantly switch between business language and technical language, and constantly surface things nobody had considered.", từ "constantly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What every day has in common: you constantly switch between business language and technical language, and constantly surface things nobody had considered.", what does "constantly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: constantly /ˈkɑːn.stənt.li/ (trạng từ): liên tục. Tính từ: constant (liên tục, không đổi); đồng nghĩa: continually.
items.explanationEn: constantly /ˈkɑːn.stənt.li/ (adverb): all the time. Adjective: constant; synonym: continually.

items.question: Trong câu "What every day has in common: you constantly switch between business language and technical language, and constantly surface things nobody had considered.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What every day has in common: you constantly switch between business language and technical language, and constantly surface things nobody had considered.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɝː.fəs/ (động từ): làm lộ ra, nêu ra. Động từ "surface" = đưa vấn đề ra ánh sáng; danh từ là "bề mặt". Cụm: surface an issue.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɝː.fəs/ (verb): to bring to attention. The verb "surface" means to bring something into view; the noun is an outer layer. Phrase: surface an issue.

items.question: Trong câu "What every day has in common: you constantly switch between business language and technical language, and constantly surface things nobody had considered.", từ "in common" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What every day has in common: you constantly switch between business language and technical language, and constantly surface things nobody had considered.", what does "in common" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in common /ɪn ˈkɑː.mən/ (cụm từ): giống nhau, chung. "Have something in common" = có điểm chung.
items.explanationEn: in common /ɪn ˈkɑː.mən/ (phrase): shared. "Have something in common" means to share a feature.

items.question: Trong câu "Role boundaries vary by company, but the centre of gravity is fairly stable:", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Role boundaries vary by company, but the centre of gravity is fairly stable:", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dɚ.i/ (danh từ): ranh giới. "Role boundaries" = ranh giới giữa các vai trò; cụm: set boundaries (đặt giới hạn).
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dɚ.i/ (noun): a dividing line. "Role boundaries" are the lines between roles; phrase: set boundaries.

items.question: Trong câu "Role boundaries vary by company, but the centre of gravity is fairly stable:", từ "vary" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Role boundaries vary by company, but the centre of gravity is fairly stable:", what does "vary" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: vary /ˈver.i/ (động từ): khác nhau, thay đổi. "Vary by company" = khác nhau tùy công ty; danh từ: variation, tính từ: various.
items.explanationEn: vary /ˈver.i/ (verb): to differ. "Vary by company" means to differ from one company to another; noun: variation; adjective: various.

items.question: Trong câu "Role boundaries vary by company, but the centre of gravity is fairly stable:", từ "centre of gravity" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Role boundaries vary by company, but the centre of gravity is fairly stable:", what does "centre of gravity" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: centre of gravity /ˈsen.tɚ əv ˈɡræv.ə.t̬i/ (cụm từ): trọng tâm, điểm cốt lõi. Nghĩa đen là "trọng tâm" (vật lý); nghĩa bóng là phần cốt lõi của một vai trò. "Gravity" riêng là trọng lực.
items.explanationEn: centre of gravity /ˈsen.tɚ əv ˈɡræv.ə.t̬i/ (phrase): the core focus. Literally a physics term; figuratively the core focus of a role. "Gravity" alone is the pull of the earth.

items.question: Trong câu "Role boundaries vary by company, but the centre of gravity is fairly stable:", từ "fairly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Role boundaries vary by company, but the centre of gravity is fairly stable:", what does "fairly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: fairly /ˈfer.li/ (trạng từ): khá, tương đối. "Fairly stable" = khá ổn định; "treat people fairly" lại là đối xử công bằng.
items.explanationEn: fairly /ˈfer.li/ (adverb): quite, rather. "Fairly stable" means quite stable; "treat people fairly" means in a just way.

items.question: Trong câu "Role boundaries vary by company, but the centre of gravity is fairly stable:", từ "stable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Role boundaries vary by company, but the centre of gravity is fairly stable:", what does "stable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (tính từ): ổn định. Danh từ: stability (sự ổn định); cụm: stable version (phiên bản ổn định).
items.explanationEn: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (adjective): steady. Noun: stability; phrase: stable version.

items.question: Trong câu "At small companies one person often wears two or three of these hats.", từ "hat" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At small companies one person often wears two or three of these hats.", what does "hat" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hat /hæt/ (danh từ): vai trò, chức trách. Thành ngữ "wear many hats" = kiêm nhiều vai trò cùng lúc.
items.explanationEn: hat /hæt/ (noun): a role one takes on. The idiom "wear many hats" means to hold several roles at once.

items.question: Trong câu "What matters is not the job title but that somebody answers those questions.", từ "title" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What matters is not the job title but that somebody answers those questions.", what does "title" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: title /ˈtaɪ.t̬əl/ (danh từ): chức danh. "Job title" = chức danh công việc; "title" còn là tên sách, danh hiệu, hoặc quyền sở hữu tài sản.
items.explanationEn: title /ˈtaɪ.t̬əl/ (noun): a position name. "Job title" is the name of a position; "title" can also be a book name, a championship or legal ownership.

items.question: Trong câu "Before the project: contribute to opportunity analysis, feasibility assessment, and help define the initial scope and business objectives.", từ "contribute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Before the project: contribute to opportunity analysis, feasibility assessment, and help define the initial scope and business objectives.", what does "contribute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contribute /kənˈtrɪb.juːt/ (động từ): đóng góp, góp phần. Cấu trúc: contribute to something; danh từ: contribution.
items.explanationEn: contribute /kənˈtrɪb.juːt/ (verb): to help bring about. Pattern: contribute to something; noun: contribution.

items.question: Trong câu "Before the project: contribute to opportunity analysis, feasibility assessment, and help define the initial scope and business objectives.", từ "feasibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Before the project: contribute to opportunity analysis, feasibility assessment, and help define the initial scope and business objectives.", what does "feasibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: feasibility /ˌfiː.zəˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): tính khả thi. "Feasibility study/assessment" = nghiên cứu/đánh giá khả thi; tính từ: feasible.
items.explanationEn: feasibility /ˌfiː.zəˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (noun): practicality. A feasibility study checks whether a project can be done; adjective: feasible.

items.question: Trong câu "Before the project: contribute to opportunity analysis, feasibility assessment, and help define the initial scope and business objectives.", từ "initial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

optionsEn: the first letter of a name
items.explanation: initial /ɪˈnɪʃ.əl/ (tính từ): ban đầu. "Initial scope" = phạm vi ban đầu; danh từ "initials" là chữ cái đầu của họ tên.
items.explanationEn: initial /ɪˈnɪʃ.əl/ (adjective): at the beginning. "Initial scope" is the scope at the start; the noun "initials" means the first letters of a name.

items.question: Trong câu "Before the project: contribute to opportunity analysis, feasibility assessment, and help define the initial scope and business objectives.", từ "objective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Before the project: contribute to opportunity analysis, feasibility assessment, and help define the initial scope and business objectives.", what does "objective" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: objective /əbˈdʒek.tɪv/ (danh từ): mục tiêu. "Business objectives" = mục tiêu kinh doanh; là tính từ, "objective" nghĩa là khách quan.
items.explanationEn: objective /əbˈdʒek.tɪv/ (noun): a goal. "Business objectives" are business goals; as an adjective, "objective" means unbiased.

items.question: Trong câu "Early in the project: elicit requirements, model current and future processes, identify stakeholders.", từ "elicit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Early in the project: elicit requirements, model current and future processes, identify stakeholders.", what does "elicit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (động từ): khai thác, thu thập. Đầu dự án, BA "elicit requirements" (khai thác yêu cầu) từ các bên liên quan.
items.explanationEn: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (verb): to draw out. Early on, the BA elicits requirements from stakeholders.

items.question: Trong câu "During development: progressively refine detail, clarify when the team asks, update as things change, join grooming and sprint planning.", từ "refine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "During development: progressively refine detail, clarify when the team asks, update as things change, join grooming and sprint planning.", what does "refine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: refine /rɪˈfaɪn/ (động từ): tinh chỉnh chi tiết. "Refine detail" = bổ sung, làm rõ chi tiết dần; cụm: backlog refinement.
items.explanationEn: refine /rɪˈfaɪn/ (verb): to improve in detail. "Refine detail" means adding and sharpening detail over time; phrase: backlog refinement.

items.question: Trong câu "During development: progressively refine detail, clarify when the team asks, update as things change, join grooming and sprint planning.", từ "grooming" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "During development: progressively refine detail, clarify when the team asks, update as things change, join grooming and sprint planning.", what does "grooming" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: grooming /ˈɡruː.mɪŋ/ (danh từ): buổi rà soát backlog. Trong Scrum, "backlog grooming" (nay gọi là refinement) là rà soát và làm rõ các story sắp làm.
items.explanationEn: grooming /ˈɡruː.mɪŋ/ (noun): reviewing the backlog. In Scrum, backlog grooming (now called refinement) means reviewing and clarifying upcoming stories.

items.question: Trong câu "Before release: support UAT, prepare user documentation, train users.", từ "release" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Before release: support UAT, prepare user documentation, train users.", what does "release" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: release /rɪˈliːs/ (danh từ): việc phát hành. Cụm hay gặp: release date (ngày phát hành), release notes (ghi chú phát hành).
items.explanationEn: release /rɪˈliːs/ (noun): making it available. Common phrases: release date, release notes.

items.question: Trong câu "After release: gather feedback, measure whether the business value actually materialised, and propose improvements.", từ "materialise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After release: gather feedback, measure whether the business value actually materialised, and propose improvements.", what does "materialise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: materialise /məˈtɪr.i.ə.laɪz/ (động từ): trở thành hiện thực. Viết kiểu Mỹ: materialize; "the value materialised" = giá trị thực sự đạt được.
items.explanationEn: materialise /məˈtɪr.i.ə.laɪz/ (verb): to become real. American spelling: materialize; "the value materialised" means it actually happened.

items.question: Trong câu "After release: gather feedback, measure whether the business value actually materialised, and propose improvements.", từ "propose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After release: gather feedback, measure whether the business value actually materialised, and propose improvements.", what does "propose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: propose /prəˈpoʊz/ (động từ): đề xuất. Danh từ: proposal (bản đề xuất); cụm: propose improvements (đề xuất cải tiến).
items.explanationEn: propose /prəˈpoʊz/ (verb): to suggest. Noun: proposal; phrase: propose improvements.

items.question: Trong câu "Many teams ship a feature and move to the next without ever checking whether it solved the original problem.", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many teams ship a feature and move to the next without ever checking whether it solved the original problem.", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): phát hành, đưa ra. Trong phần mềm, "ship a feature" = phát hành tính năng tới người dùng.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to release. In software, "ship a feature" means releasing it to users.

items.question: Trong câu "Many teams ship a feature and move to the next without ever checking whether it solved the original problem.", từ "original" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many teams ship a feature and move to the next without ever checking whether it solved the original problem.", what does "original" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: original /əˈrɪdʒ.ən.əl/ (tính từ): ban đầu, gốc. "The original problem" = vấn đề ban đầu; "an original idea" lại là ý tưởng độc đáo.
items.explanationEn: original /əˈrɪdʒ.ən.əl/ (adjective): first, earliest. "The original problem" is the first one; "an original idea" means a creative one.

items.question: Trong câu "Disciplined curiosity.", từ "disciplined" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Disciplined curiosity.", what does "disciplined" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: disciplined /ˈdɪs.ə.plɪnd/ (tính từ): có kỷ luật. "Disciplined curiosity" = tò mò có phương pháp, có kiểm soát; danh từ: discipline.
items.explanationEn: disciplined /ˈdɪs.ə.plɪnd/ (adjective): controlled and orderly. "Disciplined curiosity" is curiosity with method and control; noun: discipline.

items.question: Trong câu "Disciplined curiosity.", từ "curiosity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Disciplined curiosity.", what does "curiosity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: curiosity /ˌkjʊr.iˈɑː.sə.t̬i/ (danh từ): sự tò mò. Tính từ: curious (tò mò); cụm: out of curiosity (vì tò mò).
items.explanationEn: curiosity /ˌkjʊr.iˈɑː.sə.t̬i/ (noun): a desire to know. Adjective: curious; phrase: out of curiosity.

items.question: Trong câu "until they reach the real reason — usually a constraint that vanished long ago.", từ "vanish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "until they reach the real reason — usually a constraint that vanished long ago.", what does "vanish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: vanish /ˈvæn.ɪʃ/ (động từ): biến mất. Nhiều quy trình còn tồn tại vì một ràng buộc đã "vanished" (biến mất) từ lâu.
items.explanationEn: vanish /ˈvæn.ɪʃ/ (verb): to disappear. Many processes survive because of a constraint that vanished long ago.

items.question: Trong câu "Tolerance for ambiguity.", từ "tolerance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tolerance for ambiguity.", what does "tolerance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tolerance /ˈtɑː.lɚ.əns/ (danh từ): khả năng chịu đựng. "Tolerance for ambiguity" = khả năng chịu được sự mơ hồ; trong kỹ thuật "tolerance" là dung sai.
items.explanationEn: tolerance /ˈtɑː.lɚ.əns/ (noun): ability to accept. "Tolerance for ambiguity" is the ability to handle unclear situations; in engineering, tolerance is allowed variation.

items.question: Trong câu "The early project stage is always chaotic: contradictory information, disagreeing stakeholders, nobody with the answer.", từ "chaotic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The early project stage is always chaotic: contradictory information, disagreeing stakeholders, nobody with the answer.", what does "chaotic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: chaotic /keɪˈɑː.t̬ɪk/ (tính từ): hỗn loạn. Danh từ: chaos /ˈkeɪ.ɑːs/ (sự hỗn loạn).
items.explanationEn: chaotic /keɪˈɑː.t̬ɪk/ (adjective): in disorder. Noun: chaos /ˈkeɪ.ɑːs/.

items.question: Trong câu "The early project stage is always chaotic: contradictory information, disagreeing stakeholders, nobody with the answer.", từ "contradictory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The early project stage is always chaotic: contradictory information, disagreeing stakeholders, nobody with the answer.", what does "contradictory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contradictory /ˌkɑːn.trəˈdɪk.tɚ.i/ (tính từ): mâu thuẫn. Động từ: contradict (mâu thuẫn, nói ngược lại); danh từ: contradiction.
items.explanationEn: contradictory /ˌkɑːn.trəˈdɪk.tɚ.i/ (adjective): conflicting. Verb: contradict; noun: contradiction.

items.question: Trong câu "A good BA neither panics nor rushes to lock things down — they clarify in layers.", từ "panic" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A good BA neither panics nor rushes to lock things down — they clarify in layers.", what does "panic" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: panic /ˈpæn.ɪk/ (động từ): hoảng loạn. Chia động từ: panicked, panicking (thêm "k"); cụm: Don't panic!
items.explanationEn: panic /ˈpæn.ɪk/ (verb): to feel sudden fear. Forms: panicked, panicking (add "k"); phrase: Don't panic!

items.question: Trong câu "A good BA neither panics nor rushes to lock things down — they clarify in layers.", từ "lock down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A good BA neither panics nor rushes to lock things down — they clarify in layers.", what does "lock down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: lock down /lɑːk daʊn/ (cụm từ): chốt cứng, cố định. "Lock things down" = chốt cứng yêu cầu quá sớm; danh từ "lockdown" là lệnh phong tỏa.
items.explanationEn: lock down /lɑːk daʊn/ (phrase): to fix firmly. "Lock things down" means fixing requirements firmly too early; the noun "lockdown" means sealing off an area.

items.question: Trong câu "One ambiguous requirement sentence can cost weeks of rework.", từ "ambiguous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One ambiguous requirement sentence can cost weeks of rework.", what does "ambiguous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡ.ju.əs/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, đa nghĩa. Một câu yêu cầu "ambiguous" có thể hiểu nhiều cách, dẫn đến làm lại; danh từ: ambiguity.
items.explanationEn: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡ.ju.əs/ (adjective): unclear. An ambiguous requirement can be read in several ways and cause rework; noun: ambiguity.

items.question: Trong câu "One ambiguous requirement sentence can cost weeks of rework.", từ "rework" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One ambiguous requirement sentence can cost weeks of rework.", what does "rework" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rework /ˈriː.wɝːk/ (danh từ): việc làm lại. Tiền tố "re-" = lại: rework, rewrite; rework là chi phí ẩn lớn của yêu cầu mơ hồ.
items.explanationEn: rework /ˈriː.wɝːk/ (noun): doing work again. The prefix "re-" means again: rework, rewrite; rework is a big hidden cost of unclear requirements.

items.question: Trong câu "An underrated quality: the ability to say no constructively.", từ "underrated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An underrated quality: the ability to say no constructively.", what does "underrated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: underrated /ˌʌn.dɚˈreɪ.t̬ɪd/ (tính từ): bị đánh giá thấp. Trái nghĩa: overrated (được đánh giá quá cao).
items.explanationEn: underrated /ˌʌn.dɚˈreɪ.t̬ɪd/ (adjective): not valued enough. Opposite: overrated.

items.question: Trong câu "An underrated quality: the ability to say no constructively.", từ "constructively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An underrated quality: the ability to say no constructively.", what does "constructively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: constructively /kənˈstrʌk.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): một cách xây dựng. Cụm hay gặp: constructive feedback (góp ý mang tính xây dựng).
items.explanationEn: constructively /kənˈstrʌk.tɪv.li/ (adverb): helpfully. Common phrase: constructive feedback.

items.question: Trong câu "To be fair, this is not an easy role:", từ "to be fair" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To be fair, this is not an easy role:", what does "to be fair" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: to be fair /tə bi fer/ (cụm từ): nói cho công bằng. "To be fair" dùng để thừa nhận một mặt khác của vấn đề cho khách quan.
items.explanationEn: to be fair /tə bi fer/ (phrase): being honest and just. "To be fair" is used to admit another side of the matter.

items.question: Trong câu "You carry responsibility without authority.", từ "responsibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You carry responsibility without authority.", what does "responsibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: responsibility /rɪˌspɑːn.səˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): trách nhiệm. "Carry responsibility" = gánh trách nhiệm; cụm: take responsibility for (chịu trách nhiệm về).
items.explanationEn: responsibility /rɪˌspɑːn.səˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (noun): a duty. "Carry responsibility" means to bear a duty; phrase: take responsibility for.

items.question: Trong câu "You carry responsibility without authority.", từ "carry" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You carry responsibility without authority.", what does "carry" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: carry /ˈker.i/ (động từ): gánh, mang (trách nhiệm). Nghĩa bóng: carry responsibility/risk (gánh trách nhiệm/rủi ro); cụm: carry out (thực hiện).
items.explanationEn: carry /ˈker.i/ (verb): to bear (a duty). Figurative use: carry responsibility or risk; phrasal verb: carry out (to perform).

items.question: Trong câu "You must build consensus with no power to direct anyone.", từ "consensus" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You must build consensus with no power to direct anyone.", what does "consensus" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consensus /kənˈsen.səs/ (danh từ): sự đồng thuận. Cụm hay gặp: build/reach consensus (xây dựng/đạt được đồng thuận).
items.explanationEn: consensus /kənˈsen.səs/ (noun): general agreement. Common collocations: build consensus, reach consensus.

items.question: Trong câu "You must build consensus with no power to direct anyone.", từ "direct" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You must build consensus with no power to direct anyone.", what does "direct" (verb) mean?
options: trực tiếp, không qua trung gian
items.explanation: direct /dɪˈrekt/ (động từ): chỉ đạo, ra lệnh. BA không có quyền "direct" (chỉ đạo) ai; là tính từ, "direct" nghĩa là trực tiếp.
items.explanationEn: direct /dɪˈrekt/ (verb): to give orders to. A BA has no power to direct anyone; as an adjective, "direct" means without anything in between.

items.question: Trong câu "The business wants more and sooner; engineering wants clearer and more stable.", từ "engineering" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The business wants more and sooner; engineering wants clearer and more stable.", what does "engineering" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: engineering /ˌen.dʒɪˈnɪr.ɪŋ/ (danh từ): đội kỹ thuật. Trong công ty công nghệ, "engineering" thường chỉ đội phát triển/kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: engineering /ˌen.dʒɪˈnɪr.ɪŋ/ (noun): the technical team. In tech companies, "engineering" usually means the development team.

items.question: Trong câu "A misunderstood requirement is only discovered once the product is built.", từ "misunderstand" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A misunderstood requirement is only discovered once the product is built.", what does "misunderstand" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: misunderstand /ˌmɪs.ʌn.dɚˈstænd/ (động từ): hiểu sai. Danh từ: misunderstanding (sự hiểu lầm); cụm: clear up a misunderstanding.
items.explanationEn: misunderstand /ˌmɪs.ʌn.dɚˈstænd/ (verb): to get wrong. Noun: misunderstanding; phrase: clear up a misunderstanding.

items.question: Trong câu "Your mistakes surface very late.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Your mistakes surface very late.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɝː.fəs/ (động từ): lộ ra, xuất hiện. "Mistakes surface late" = lỗi lộ ra muộn; nghĩa gốc là nổi lên mặt nước.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɝː.fəs/ (verb): to come to light. "Mistakes surface late" means they become visible late; literally, to rise to the top of water.

items.question: Trong câu "When you do it well, everything flows and nobody notices.", từ "flow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you do it well, everything flows and nobody notices.", what does "flow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: flow /floʊ/ (động từ): diễn ra suôn sẻ. "Everything flows" = mọi thứ trôi chảy; danh từ: workflow (luồng công việc).
items.explanationEn: flow /floʊ/ (verb): to run smoothly. "Everything flows" means it all runs smoothly; related noun: workflow.

items.question: Trong câu "When you do it well, everything flows and nobody notices.", từ "notice" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you do it well, everything flows and nobody notices.", what does "notice" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: notice /ˈnoʊ.t̬ɪs/ (động từ): để ý, nhận thấy. Là danh từ, "notice" = thông báo; cụm: give notice (báo nghỉ việc).
items.explanationEn: notice /ˈnoʊ.t̬ɪs/ (verb): to become aware of. As a noun, "notice" is an announcement; phrase: give notice (announce you are leaving a job).

items.question: Trong câu "In exchange: the BA is one of the few roles that sees the whole picture — from business problem to the last line of code.", từ "in exchange" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In exchange: the BA is one of the few roles that sees the whole picture — from business problem to the last line of code.", what does "in exchange" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in exchange /ɪn ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/ (cụm từ): bù lại, đổi lại. "In exchange for something" = để đổi lấy cái gì.
items.explanationEn: in exchange /ɪn ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ/ (phrase): in return. "In exchange for something" means in return for it.

items.question: Trong câu "In exchange: the BA is one of the few roles that sees the whole picture — from business problem to the last line of code.", từ "the whole picture" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In exchange: the BA is one of the few roles that sees the whole picture — from business problem to the last line of code.", what does "the whole picture" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: the whole picture /ðə hoʊl ˈpɪk.tʃɚ/ (cụm từ): bức tranh toàn cảnh. Đồng nghĩa: the big picture; trái với "chỉ thấy một phần".
items.explanationEn: the whole picture /ðə hoʊl ˈpɪk.tʃɚ/ (phrase): the full situation. Synonym: the big picture; the opposite of seeing only one part.

items.question: Trong câu "That is an excellent foundation for moving on to Product Owner, Product Manager, consultant, or management.", từ "foundation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is an excellent foundation for moving on to Product Owner, Product Manager, consultant, or management.", what does "foundation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: foundation /faʊnˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): nền tảng. "A foundation for" = nền tảng để tiến tới; cụm: lay the foundation (đặt nền móng).
items.explanationEn: foundation /faʊnˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a base to build on. "A foundation for" is a base to build on; phrase: lay the foundation.

items.question: Trong câu "That is an excellent foundation for moving on to Product Owner, Product Manager, consultant, or management.", từ "consultant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is an excellent foundation for moving on to Product Owner, Product Manager, consultant, or management.", what does "consultant" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consultant /kənˈsʌl.tənt/ (danh từ): nhà tư vấn. Động từ: consult (tham khảo ý kiến); danh từ: consultancy (công ty tư vấn).
items.explanationEn: consultant /kənˈsʌl.tənt/ (noun): an expert adviser. Verb: consult; noun: consultancy.

items.question: Trong câu "That is an excellent foundation for moving on to Product Owner, Product Manager, consultant, or management.", từ "move on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is an excellent foundation for moving on to Product Owner, Product Manager, consultant, or management.", what does "move on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: move on /muːv ɑːn/ (cụm từ): chuyển sang bước mới. "Move on to" = chuyển sang (vai trò, chủ đề) tiếp theo.
items.explanationEn: move on /muːv ɑːn/ (phrase): to progress to something new. "Move on to" means to go forward to the next role or topic.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA turns business needs into something buildable, and technical capability into something understandable.", từ "buildable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA turns business needs into something buildable, and technical capability into something understandable.", what does "buildable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: buildable /ˈbɪl.də.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể xây dựng được. Hậu tố "-able" = có thể: buildable, understandable, testable.
items.explanationEn: buildable /ˈbɪl.də.bəl/ (adjective): able to be built. The suffix "-able" means can be: buildable, understandable, testable.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA has responsibility without authority, so influence must come from professional credibility.", từ "credibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA has responsibility without authority, so influence must come from professional credibility.", what does "credibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: credibility /ˌkred.əˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): uy tín, sự tín nhiệm. Tính từ: credible (đáng tin); cụm: build credibility (xây dựng uy tín).
items.explanationEn: credibility /ˌkred.əˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (noun): trustworthiness. Adjective: credible; phrase: build credibility.

items.question: Trong câu "The work stretches from before the project starts to after the product ships.", từ "stretch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The work stretches from before the project starts to after the product ships.", what does "stretch" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: stretch /stretʃ/ (động từ): kéo dài, trải dài. "Stretch from A to B" = trải dài từ A đến B; "stretch goal" = mục tiêu thử thách.
items.explanationEn: stretch /stretʃ/ (verb): to extend over. "Stretch from A to B" means to extend over that range; "stretch goal" means a challenging target.

items.question: Trong câu "It demands patience with ambiguity and discipline in digging to root causes, and repays that with a whole-picture view few roles ever get.", từ "root cause" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It demands patience with ambiguity and discipline in digging to root causes, and repays that with a whole-picture view few roles ever get.", what does "root cause" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: root cause /ruːt kɑːz/ (danh từ): nguyên nhân gốc rễ. Cụm hay gặp: root cause analysis (phân tích nguyên nhân gốc rễ).
items.explanationEn: root cause /ruːt kɑːz/ (noun): the underlying reason. Common phrase: root cause analysis.

items.question: Trong câu "It demands patience with ambiguity and discipline in digging to root causes, and repays that with a whole-picture view few roles ever get.", từ "repay" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It demands patience with ambiguity and discipline in digging to root causes, and repays that with a whole-picture view few roles ever get.", what does "repay" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: repay /rɪˈpeɪ/ (động từ): đền đáp, bù đắp. Nghĩa bóng: nghề BA "repays" sự kiên nhẫn bằng góc nhìn toàn cảnh; nghĩa đen là trả nợ.
items.explanationEn: repay /rɪˈpeɪ/ (verb): to reward in return. Figuratively, the job repays patience with a whole-picture view; literally, to pay back money.
